name: Depth Structural Consistency Regularization
definition: A regularization term applied to NeRF depth pixels to enforce continuity constraints derived from a depth map (e.g., from DepthAnythingV2), accounting for minor depth variations between neighboring pixels using a boundary value.
summary: Depth Structural Consistency Regularization enforces depth continuity in NeRF training by penalizing large discontinuities between rendered and prior maps using k-nearest neighbor relationships in depth space.
